name: Lurr
description: Lurr was a planet in the Outer Rim's Rayter sector. One of the stormtroopers that accompanied the Sith Lord Darth Vader to Cheelit killed a young woman while on the planet. The Guild of Vindicators assassin Clat the Shamer later used the memories of that event to compel the soldier to commit suicide.
lead_paragraphs: Lurr was a planet in the Outer Rim's Rayter sector. One of the stormtroopers that accompanied the Sith Lord Darth Vader to Cheelit killed a young woman while on the planet.
